summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests TER-2013 in people with advanced solid tumors that have changes in the AKT/PI3K/PTEN pathway. The conditions listed include breast, endometrial, ovarian, cervical, lung, head and neck, and esophageal cancers. TER-2013 is taken by mouth as capsules or tablets, and some arms also receive fulvestrant as an intramuscular injection; how long or how often is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and anti-tumor activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa TER-2013 en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados que presentan cambios en la vía AKT/PI3K/PTEN. Las condiciones incluyen cáncer de mama, endometrio, ovario, cuello uterino, pulmón, cabeza y cuello, y esófago. TER-2013 se toma por vía oral en cápsulas o tabletas, y algunos grupos también reciben fulvestrant por inyección intramuscular; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Metastatic or locally advanced, unresectable solid tumor with an AKT/PI3K/PTEN pathway alteration found by a sponsor-approved test.
No available treatment with curative intent.
Measurable or evaluable disease per RECIST v1.1 (measurable disease for expansion cohorts).
not_for: Known EGFR, KRAS, NRAS, HRAS, or BRAF co-mutation with a PI3K/AKT/PTEN alteration.
Clinically significant abnormalities of glucose metabolism.
Active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Significant hemoptysis or hemorrhage within 4 weeks before first dose.
Malabsorption, uncontrolled nausea and vomiting, or GI disease likely to affect drug absorption.
